data.heading: Frequently asked questions

data.html: Frequently asked questions about Larkspur Supply Co. membership and rentals.

items.question: What is the member dividend?
items.answer: Each spring, members get back a share of the profit, based on what they bought the year before. Last year it was 8%.

items.question: Can I rent gear without being a member?
How do I return a rental?
items.answer: Bring it to the rental desk by closing time on the return date. Late returns cost one extra day.

items.question: Do you repair gear you didn't sell?
items.answer: Yes, we repair any brand. Estimates are free.

items.question: Can I cancel my membership?
items.answer: Yes. We refund your $30 if you cancel within 30 days.
